correctness.rationale: For nonempty primary neighbor sets A,B, represent uniformly random removal order by continuous iid priorities. With union size u and d=n-u outside vertices, decompose T_A=J_A+sum X_z and T_B=J_B+sum Y_z; restricted-order covariance C0=-((a-c)(b-c))/((a+1)(b+1)) and maxima covariance C_M=c/((a+1)(b+1)(u+2)). Conditional covariance for outside indicators gives exact formula (n+1)/((a+1)(b+1))*(c*(n-u)/(u+2)-(a-c)*(b-c)/(u+1)). Diagonal and disjoint boundaries checked. Robustness R=sum T_Ai/(m(n+1)) makes variance pairwise sum. Independent exhaustive primary-permutation enumeration for ALL nonempty ordered (A,B) at n=2..6 (9,49,225,961,3969 pairs) matched exact rational formula; both four-primary two-regular graphs enumerated over 24 removal orders: 1/1800 versus 1/450, means 2/3. Finite tests support, but universal proof is priority-order conditioning.
